source: Producer message after blind freeze; implementation remains unread.
semantics: Null-prototype records are accepted when they contain exactly the two own key/label data properties.
Nonenumerable required own data properties and array slots are accepted.
originalPosition in returned records is one-based; comparison/exchange indices are zero-based.
sortedPrefix guarantees a currently sorted leading segment, may shrink inside an insertion pass, and does not mean fixed final positions.
A compare step's three-way narration does not add a second counted predicate; count tracks the declared strict-less-than decision.
